warnings: First of two beam-detail sheets; S-15/หน้า42 carries B5, B6, RB1 and RB2. Between them they cover every beam mark used on the floor and ring-beam plans (S-04/S-05/S-06) except 'B2X', which appears on no detail sheet in this extraction — B2X's plans show it as a continuation of B2, so its section is presumably B2's, but that is not printed anywhere and it is NOT recorded here as an element.

Stirrup spacing varies along every beam drawn in elevation (B2, B3, B4): closer at the ends, wider in the middle. Recorded as stirrup.spacing_mm = the END spacing with variable_spacing true, and the full zoning written into stirrup.note — B2 and B3 use 'L/4 แต่ไม่น้อยกว่า 0.80' end zones (a quarter of the span, minimum 0.80m), while B4 is drawn at a fixed 4.00m span with 1.00m end zones. The first stirrup sits 0.05m clear of the support face.

B4's bottom steel is 4ø16มม, recorded as a single main_bar.bottom count of 4 with NO additional_bars — Makham's call, 2026-08-26. The elevation prints it as two separate '2ø16มม.' leaders and draws one of the pairs with hooked ends stopping 0.50m short of each support, but neither leader carries a curtailment note and section 4-4 states the total flatly as '4ø16มม.'. That makes it four bottom bars detailed with hooks, not a main layer plus a curtailed extra layer. Contrast house 33's B4, where the second pair WAS extra because it carried its own 'หยุดที่ L/8' note — the note is what distinguishes the two cases.

'ต่อเนื่องจาก B<n>' on B3X and B4X ('continuing from B3'/'from B4') means the X-mark is a lap-splice/continuation segment of its base mark and reuses its top and bottom bars; recorded verbatim in each bar's note. B3X additionally carries '1ø16มม. (ล้วงเข้า B3 ยาวไม่น้อยกว่า 1.20 ม.)' — one extra Ø16 top bar lapping into B3 by at least 1.20m — recorded under additional_bars.

The '0.30' dimension printed at the left end of each beam elevation is the STIRRUP height, not a member dimension: it is the 0.40 overall depth less 0.05 cover top and bottom. Only the 0.40 is recorded as height_mm.
Bar-type convention: ø6มม stirrups recorded as 'RB' (plain round), ø12มม and larger as 'DB' (deformed). The sheet prints only 'ø' and 'ป' (ปลอก = stirrup).
